ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:3 ratio of high-intensity (white/tan) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large irregular white/tan pigmentation blob occupies the distal-central region of the right lobe; thin white linear band on the distal leading edge of the left lobe; dense white mottling at the peduncle water-line.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 115-120 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude (5-10 pixel) serrations along the right lobe trailing edge; left lobe trailing edge is largely obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the distal margins of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small white circular pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tip of the left lobe and scattered across the peduncle base.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct set of parallel white linear marks (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the lower black field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged indentation or irregular loss of material at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Tan/yellowish discoloration visible within the primary white pigmentation patch on the right lobe.
